name: 19939-textdecode-qwen25vl3b-1gpu
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, 3.75B params; language side 36 layers, hidden 2048, 16 query heads, 2 KV heads (head dim 128), vocab 151936.
workload: single-turn text completion, 256 prompt tokens in and 1024 tokens out, both exact (min == max); prompts distinct per request.
purpose: A long-form text generation service for writers, serving 256 concurrent users from a compact multimodal model on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine flags for vLLM built at commit 3014c920dae5a2360b9b4141395522cc52b59193.
# Keys are this engine generation's AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown one fails at construction.
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct
enable-prefix-caching: false
disable-log-requests: true
max-num-seqs: 1024
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 4096
